changeSet.sql:
INSERT INTO claim_settlement_log ( settlement_id, settlement_no, financial_document_id, claim_request_id, action, claim_status, note, created_by, created_date ) SELECT event.settlement_id, event.settlement_no, event.financial_document_id, event.claim_request_id, event.action, event.claim_status, event.note, event.created_by, event.created_date FROM ( -- The invoice was grouped under the statement. SELECT line.settlement_id, settlement.settlement_no, line.financial_document_id, NULL::bigint AS claim_request_id, 'ADDED' AS action, NULL AS claim_status, NULL AS note, COALESCE(line.created_by, 'system') AS created_by, line.created_date FROM claim_settlement_invoice line JOIN claim_settlement settlement ON settlement.id = line.settlement_id
UNION ALL
-- A claim was opened for the invoice under that statement. SELECT line.settlement_id, settlement.settlement_no, line.financial_document_id, claim.id, 'CLAIM_LINKED', claim.status, NULL, COALESCE(claim.created_by, 'system'), claim.created_date FROM claim_settlement_invoice line JOIN claim_settlement settlement ON settlement.id = line.settlement_id JOIN claim_request claim ON claim.id = line.claim_request_id
UNION ALL
-- The claim was rejected, failed or returned, so the invoice left the statement. SELECT line.settlement_id, settlement.settlement_no, line.financial_document_id, line.claim_request_id, 'RELEASED', claim.status, line.release_reason, COALESCE(line.last_modified_by, line.created_by, 'system'), COALESCE(line.released_at, line.last_modified_date) FROM claim_settlement_invoice line JOIN claim_settlement settlement ON settlement.id = line.settlement_id LEFT JOIN claim_request claim ON claim.id = line.claim_request_id WHERE line.membership_status = 'RELEASED' ) event WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM claim_settlement_log logged WHERE logged.settlement_id = event.settlement_id AND logged.financial_document_id = event.financial_document_id AND logged.action = event.action AND logged.claim_request_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM event.claim_request_id ) ORDER BY event.created_date, event.action;
